limitations: This code-only candidate does not recover or change the currently stalled Production run.

The existing SDK still masks transport and SQL errors under DATABASE_RPC_REJECTED; this patch does not claim a new classifier.
If FINISH succeeds after an earlier error, the existing normal result remains unchanged; recovery applies only when FINISH itself rejects.
C source admission must be resealed and independently reviewed before any deployment. No old seal was edited.
